title: Sulfur Cubed
description: Inspired by a Phoenix SC video - turns the player into a sulfur cube, completely changing how you play the game
body:
# Sulfur Cubed Boing boing weeeeee
## Why? Just a fun thing I thought I could do ## Description This mod is based on Phoenix SC's ["I beat Minecraft as a SULFUR CUBE."](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IzUh8AkonE4) YouTube video,
but improves on a few aspects of his datapack and also making it a configurable mod!

You can only have one item at a time in your inventory, and you can't pick up anything if you already have something in your hand,
you bounce and slide around depending on what you're holding, and you only have 4 hearts,
but you are invournable to falls, meele, projectiles, explosions etc.
(all damage sources that a Sulfur Cube is immune to) when holding something, and you're only 1 block tall just like a regular Sulfur Cube.

By default you can still use your offhand and equip armor, but you can disable that in `config\sulfurcubed.properties`,
if you'd like an extra challange.
## Notice Sulfur Cubed was not made for stuff like your survival world or big modpack and stuff like that.
This mod is supposed to be more for shortly trying it out alone or with friends, having some fun and laughs and that's it.
This mod also modifies vanilla GUI textures and the Barrier item texture for the "only one item at a time" feature.
